I went to university after highschool for one year , I took architecture and realized it wasn't for me !

I then went to college and learned 3d animation for two years. After graduating I had a part time job teaching a manga/comics class at an art centre! At the same time I began publishing Toxic For You on tapas, and attending local pop culture conventions selling my merch

After about 3 years I got heavy burn out from working two jobs (also worked for a hotel in banquets), conventions and working on my webcomic. I took a year off my webcomic and got a more financially stable job as a receptionist at a car dealership.
A year later, I (mistakenly) accepted a promotion to internet sales manager, and the environment became so toxic I had to leave three months after being promoted, I was unemployed for three months !
I then miraculously got an actual illustrator job in my city. I've been here for almost a year now, creating and designing picture and activity books for Native Canadians.
